WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o."timespan", COUNT(DISTINCT o."recordvault") AS order_count
  FROM "riskandmargin" AS r
  JOIN "orders" AS o
    ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault"
  GROUP BY o."timespan"
), shares AS (
  SELECT "timespan", order_count,
         order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT "timespan",
       order_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean across the time-in-force values present among matched orders; NULL timespan, if present, is treated as a value.
